description: This file implements the HealthcheckService class, which manages periodic health checks (pings) to servers, handles acknowledgments, and manages server state changes based on ping responses. It includes methods for sending pings, handling ping sent acknowledgments, receiving acknowledgments, and removing servers from monitoring.

classes.name: HealthcheckService
classes.description: A class responsible for performing periodic health checks on servers by sending pings, handling responses, and managing server states based on ping acknowledgments.

methods.name: HealthcheckService
methods.description: Constructor that initializes the health check interval timer if the interval is non-zero.

methods.name: ~HealthcheckService
methods.description: Destructor that cancels and resets the health check timer if active.

methods.name: onPingSent
methods.description: Handles the event when a ping is sent to a server, verifying the ping ID and tracking the server.

methods.name: onAckReceived
methods.description: Handles acknowledgment from a server, updating server status and handling errors.

methods.name: onServerRemoved
methods.description: Removes a server from the monitoring list.

methods.name: sendPing
methods.description: Sends a ping to all remaining servers, handles timeouts, and initiates the next ping cycle.
